english.note: Use this when luxury refers to lavish comforts or the luxurious surroundings they provide, rather than to a particular item.

examples.english: The luxury this hotel provides is truly unforgettable.
examples.traditional: 呢間酒店提供嘅豪華享受，真係令人難忘。
